in_sanskrit.name: धरुविन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dhruvin is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dhru’ meaning stability or foundation, and ‘vin’ meaning destruction or annihilation. Thus, Dhruvin can be interpreted as the one who brings about the destruction of stability or foundation.

in_hindi.name: धरुविन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Dhruvin in Hindi is a translation of the Sanskrit name धरुविन्. It retains the same meaning of destruction of stability or foundation.

in_tamil.name: தருவின்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Dhruvin in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit name धरुविन्. It is transliterated as தருவின் and can be interpreted as the great destroyer.

in_telugu.name: ధరువిన్

in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Dhruvin in Telugu is a transliteration of the Sanskrit name धरुविन्. It can be interpreted as the destroyer of great foundations or the one who yields the power to destroy.

in_marathi.name: Dhruvin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sky, Universe, World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruva is the name of a famous celestial being in Hindu mythology. He is the embodiment of unwavering determination and dedication. Dhruva, the son of King Uttanpada, was known for his unwavering devotion to Lord Vishnu. He was given a boon by Lord Vishnu that he would attain the position of the North Star, Polaris. Dhruva's unwavering spirit and devotion are symbolized in the name Dhruvin.
